claims.text: The contract sets a 3-year initial term. Neither party gets a right to end it for convenience during that term, and the excerpts show no such right.

citations.quote: The initial term of this Agreement shall be for 3 years

claims.text: Either party may terminate only for the other party's breach, and only after 10 days' prior written notice and an opportunity to cure during that 10-day period.

citations.quote: Either party hereto shall have the right to terminate this Agreement in the event of a breach by the other party of its obligations hereunder, subject to 10 days prior written notice of such breach
and the opportunity for such breaching party to cure such breach during such 10 day period.

claims.text: Either Charterer or Owner may elect not to renew by written notice 30 days before expiration of the Initial Term or a Renewal Term. This is non-renewal, not termination for convenience, and it takes effect at the end of the current term.

citations.quote: unless either Charterer or Owner elects not to renew this Agreement by providing the other party with written notice of such election 30 days prior to the expiration of the Initial Term or Renewal Term, as applicable, at which point this Agreement will automatically terminate.

claims.text: If the parties do not agree on a renegotiated fee by the start of a Renewal Term, the agreement terminates automatically. This is also not a termination-for-convenience right.

citations.quote: If no such agreement on such fee is reached by such parties by the commencement of a Renewal Term, this Agreement shall automatically terminate.
